selection_rationale: C1 directly targets a central, actionable NetOps reliability gap (generate→validate→repair with a verifier), has a clear paired experimental design and statistical plan, fits the venue and compute budget, and is judged feasible by reviewers provided the listed design repairs are implemented.
unresolved_uncertainties: Degree to which Batfish sandbox semantics match real production-device/vendor quirks
Risk that repair loops will overfit to Batfish checks and introduce undetected regressions
Prompt/model-call nondeterminism and sensitivity across seeds or model versions
Generalisability across vendors/protocols and heterogeneous topologies
Potential for provider/API failures or rate limits to bias paired comparisons
required_repairs_before_preregistration: Precisely specify validator properties and the sandbox harm-oracle (explicit checks: reachability, ACL/policy violations, routing loops, interface-state regressions) and document Batfish config versions used.

Pre-register exact model identifiers, model versions, all prompt templates (including repair prompts), prompt variants, random seeds, maximum model-call budget per task, retry policy, and logging/trace schema.

Add secondary, orthogonal checks to detect verifier-overfitting (e.g., randomized test-packet probes, alternate verifier or independent reachability tests, and performance/regression tests) and pre-register their use.
Define and publicize the dataset: release task corpus, topologies, vendor-syntax templates, Batfish scenarios, and all experiment code/configs with hashes and reproducibility instructions.

Clarify vendor stratification and sampling rules; ensure balanced representation across vendor-like syntaxes (e.g., IOS-like, JunOS-like) and complexity strata; pre-register inclusion/exclusion criteria.

Operationalize precise definitions for ‘validator-detected error’ and repair-success metrics and pre-register primary/secondary outcomes, statistical tests (McNemar/bootstraps), confidence-interval methods, and stopping rules.
Implement unit and integration tests for the generate→validate→repair pipeline; include test fixtures that exercise edge cases to rule out integration bugs before data collection.

Specify artifact sanitization and ethical safeguards: experiments limited to sandbox/non-production topologies, no production device access, and a release policy that avoids publishing exploitable adversarial artifacts.
Commit to public artifact release (code, batfish scenarios, data) and a reproducibility checklist (build/run steps, environment versions) as part of the preregistration.
